title: docs(tonewood): reconcile African vs Malaysian blackwoods duplication (O-05)
intent: Resolve O-05's remaining duplication by making tonewood_comparison_acacia_family_blackwoods_koa.md the shared Acacia-family reference and tonewood_comparison_blackwoods_african_vs_malaysian.md the focused African-versus-Malaysian comparison. Overlap was classified in a ledger before prose edits. Unique comparison material stays. No new scientific conclusion. This grants no purchasing, regulatory, engineering, or manufacturing authority and does not validate the measurements.
behavior_change: none - documentation-only. No numerical-data authority change. No runtime, API, client, CAM, manufacturing, purchasing, or CITES authority change. wood_species.json is untouched. FPL policy examples and the extracted FPL source table are untouched.

constraints.method: overlap ledger: every original blackwoods section has one disposition (KEEP_COMPARISON, MOVE_TO_SHARED_REFERENCE, REPLACE_WITH_LINK, KEEP_WITH_CAVEAT, PRESERVE_HISTORICAL_ONLY, or REQUIRES_SEPARATE_VERIFICATION) recorded in docs/investigations/tonewood-verification-003/BLACKWOODS_RECONCILIATION.md before the prose was treated as settled
constraints.tests: scripts/ci/test_tonewood_blackwoods_reconciliation.py, named in core_ci.yml because scripts/ci is not collected wholesale. In-test fixtures plant a duplicate passage and a changed 17.95 without writing the repo. A cross-record check requires the log status line, the O-05 row, the C-09 heading, the reconciliation record and this manifest to agree that O-05 is resolved as duplication only; negative controls plant the old C-09 heading and two contradicting status statements taken from earlier wording.
constraints.manual_checks: citation strings were not retargeted; reciprocal markdown links were read in both documents; numeric tokens in the blackwoods document were compared with the pre-change text and none were removed

diff_articulation.what_changed: Blackwoods document restated as a focused comparison with purpose, identity table, unchanged property tables, use and regulatory notes, gaps, and a link to the Acacia-family document. Acacia document gains a Focused comparisons link, drops two sentences that asserted Malaysian Blackwood is Acacia melanoxylon, and drops the short ranking table whose figures already lived in the comparison. VERIFICATION_LOG marks O-05 resolved as duplication only. New structural test and investigation record. Review fix: the C-09 heading now says it resolved the extreme-density part of O-05, and the reconciliation record states O-05 as resolved as duplication only.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: O-05 still called the blackwoods document a repeat of the Acacia document, and the Acacia document still asserted an identity its own C-07 caution denies. No existing test checks the split, the reciprocal links, or that the withdrawn identity sentences stay withdrawn.
